newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $1.2 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $1.2 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $1.2 billion in 26 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $788 million in 12 sales, with a $490 million NYC Municipal Assistance Corp. issue through Morgan Stanley topping the list.
On the competitive side, 14 sales totaling $415 million are on the schedule. A $240 million Maryland deal at 1100 EST is the largest.

An additional four sales totaling $216 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday, depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
